segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func stretchCrop(inputImage: CIImage) -> CIImage { let filter = CIFilter.stretchCrop() filter.inputImage = inputImage filter.cropAmount = 0.25 filter.centerStretchAmount = 0.25 filter.size = CGPoint( x: inputImage.extent.width * 2, y: inputImage.extent.size.height * 0.8 ) return filter.outputImage! } ```
